aboutSettings.featuresDescription: This application regroups a set of features around MIDI:
aboutSettings.featureDisplay: Display chords, notes and a piano as you play
aboutSettings.featureIntegrate: Integrate in OBS, or in your Web Browser
aboutSettings.featureLearn: Learn with tools like Chord Quiz and Circle of Fifths
aboutSettings.planToAdd: I plan to add new modules, so don't hesitate to
aboutSettings.specialMentionsDescription: MIDI Jar is based on a collection of amazing open-source projects and resources that deserve special mentions:

creditDescriptions.tonal: A functional music theory library for Javascript, that enabled MIDI Jar to detect chords, and handle MIDI notes easily
creditDescriptions.vexflow: A JavaScript library for rendering music notation and guitar tablature.
creditDescriptions.julusianMidi: A node.js wrapper for the RtMidi C++ library that provides realtime MIDI I/O. Forked from @justinlatimer/node-midi.
creditDescriptions.reactFlow: Highly customizable library for building interactive node-based UIs, editors, flow charts and diagrams. It allows MIDI Jar to have understandable MIDI routing with nodes and draggable edges.
creditDescriptions.electronBoilerplate: A Foundation for Scalable Cross-Platform Apps in Electron, the base boilerplate for MIDI Jar.
creditDescriptions.flaticon: Most MIDI Jar icons are based on the Flaticon's <uicons> icon pack.

overlay.description: You can use this local website as a BrowserSource in OBS to integrate MIDI Jar as an overlay, or load it on another device to use MIDI Jar remotely. Settings can be edited directly through the main application.
